item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a mirror fixed at a sharp bend on a road near Yash’s colony so drivers can see traffic around the corner.

Why is a convex mirror chosen for this use?

options.A: It forms erect, smaller images and gives a wider field of view than a plane mirror
options.B: It forms a magnified image so distant vehicles look larger than life
options.C: Any curved mirror works the same, so concave would serve equally well here
options.D: It is chosen only because the glass looks shiny, not because of image size or field of view
